comparison: self-checking directed program checking a 64-call running total, a first-to-last call cycle ratio, and the distinct return values of two alternated routines whose addresses differ only in bit 13 and select the same cache set, through a mailbox exit code (0xff pass, 0x01 fail)
completion_classification: An interrupted build or simulation, or a log without the Verilator command because the fixed program did not build or stale build artifacts were reused, is INVALID. The sole TEST_PASSED marker is PASS. TEST_FAILED, the cycle-limit marker, a nonzero build or simulation exit, conflicting markers and an absent verdict are FAIL.
